# InlineConfirm

Ask-in-place confirm with an undo fuse — the default way to take a decision a thread is waiting on.

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.InlineConfirm`

## Use

```jsx
<OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.InlineConfirm label={…} confirmLabel="…" onConfirm={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.InlineConfirm" label="{{…}}" confirm-label="…" on-confirm="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Inline confirm (Bencho "say", web/src ui.tsx). A pill that asks in place: label → Cancel | Confirm → Done + Undo with a burning fuse; `onConfirm` runs when the fuse is out. The shell springs between widths (340ms spring). `needs` fills the confirm half in vermilion — use it when the action resolves a waiting decision. @startingPoint section="Forms" subtitle="Ask-in-place confirm with undo fuse" viewport="700x160"
